ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, IBM shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Content in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Content from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard exit clause to Section 3.5 so that, on termination, IBM provides up to six months of paid transition assistance and returns our Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days before deleting it and certifying deletion. The Agreement is currently silent on data return and wind-down, which would leave our hosted data stranded; we can accept a 90-day assistance period as a fallback.
input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Content return/deletion obligation in § 3.5.
